title: Move with Arrow Keys (3D)
content: **List of Contents** Move Patterns with Arrow Keys Set Specific Movement Increment **Objective** Select Patterns in the 3D window, then use the arrow keys on the keyboard to move them in specific increments. ** Location** **Move Patterns with Arrow Keys ** Main Menu ▶ 3D Garment ▶ **Select/Move ** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![Toolbar_3D_Select_Move.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115024342428/Toolbar_3D_Select_Move.png) **Select/Move** **Set Specific Movement Increment ** Main Menu ▶ Preferences ▶ Grid Properties ▶ Property Editor ▶ 3D Grid ▶ **3D Arrow Key Movement** Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on 3D/2D Window) ▶ Grid Properties ▶ Property Editor ▶ 3D Grid ▶ **3D Arrow Key Movement** **Operation** **Move Patterns with Arrow Keys** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 3D Garment ▶ **Select/Move ** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![Toolbar_3D_Select_Move.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115024342428/Toolbar_3D_Select_Move.png) **Select/Move** ** ** 2. Select Patterns or trims in the 3D window. → Selected Patterns or trims are highlighted in yellow. 3. Use the arrow keys on the keyboard to move the selected Pattern or trim. **Arrow Keys** | **Description** ---|--- ▲ | Move selected Patterns or trims along or towards the positive y-axis. The Garment moves upwards. ▼ | Move selected Patterns or trims along or towards the negative y-axis. The Garment moves downwards. ◀ | Move selected Patterns or trims along or towards the negative x-axis. The Garment moves to the left. ▶ | Move selected Patterns or trims along or towards the positive x-axis. The Garment moves to the right. **▲ + Ctrl** | Move selected Patterns or trims along or towards the negative z-axis. The Garment moves away from you. **▼ + Ctrl** | Move selected Patterns or trims along or towards the positive z-axis. The Garment moves towards you. **Set Specific Movement Increment** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Preferences ▶ Grid Properties ▶ Property Editor ▶ **3D Arrow Key Movement** Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on 3D Window) ▶ Grid Properties ▶ Property Editor ▶ **3D Arrow Key Movement** 2. Enter the desired distance moved with each arrow key input. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on how to effectively move patterns in a 3D environment using arrow keys and set specific movement increments.

title: Linear Avatar Tape
content: **List of Contents** Linear Avatar Tape Create Tape Create Tape in Guidelines **Linear Avatar Tape** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IQhfRlenVv0 \- Apply Linear Avatar Tapes to Avatars in the 3D window. \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022403087/mceclip2.png) **Linear Avatar Tape** tool from the 3D toolbar. \- Or, navigate the Main Menu and select Avatar ▶ Avatar Tape ▶ **Linear Avatar Tape.** ** Create Tape** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bMj3gXVk6Ig \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022403087/mceclip2.png) **Linear Avatar Tape** tool from the 3D toolbar. \- Click to create the start point of the Avatar Tape on the Avatar. title: [2D Tool] 1:N Free Sewing
content: **Objective ** Freely establish Sewing Lines on Pattern outlines and Internal Shapes/Lines to sew multiple Patterns to a single Pattern (ver2.2.0). ** Location** Main Menu ▶ Sewing ▶**Free Sewing** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001244107/_______.png) **Free Sewing** ** Operation** 1. Establish the start and the end point on the Pattern outline, which is called as 1, where multiple Patterns are sewn to. 3. Hold down the Shift key on the keyboard. → The Sewing Line appears in neon color. 4. While holding down the Shift key, establish Sewing Lines on N Patterns. title: CLO Account Integration User Guide
content: *This FAQ is intended for existing CLO users. # **Objective** **Access all CLO Virtual Fashion services using a single email account.** This FAQ will cover the updates and changes to login methods for **CLO** **Individual** & **Student** license account types. This change will not affect Enterprise & Academic account types at this time. Please check the [general FAQ](https://clovf.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/sections/9021928318863-General) if you have questions about the account merging process (CLO-SET accounts). # **Details** **1) Change in login method** **Effective from the next released version, CLO 2024.0** **What does this cover?** CLO website / Software version 2024.0 and above | **Software Version** **(7.3 and below)** | **Software Version** **Above 2024.0** ---|---|--- **How to login** | **Existing License ID & Password** | **CLO-SET ID & Password ** **2) How do I get a “CLO-SET ID & Password” if I have an existing CLO account? ** Check out our detailed step-by-step guide **[here](https://clovf.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/9021921372047-Account-Merging-from-CLO-SET)**. **3) What is the difference between a CLO-SET account and my previous CLO account?** With your old CLO account you had to have multiple logins to access all of the CLO Virtual Fashion (CVF) products and services. Now with one CLO-SET account you can access all CLO Virtual Fashion services without additional logins. If you choose to login to the websites for any of the CLO Virtual Fashion (CVF) products and services you will be prompted to merge your account logins into a CLO-SET account. **4) How do I login to CLO / Marvelous Designer / Jinny after I merge my account?** You can login to CLO / Marvelous Designer / Jinny with your CLO-SET ID & Password. **5) I have a subscription license for CLO and I like to use an older version than 2024.0. Do I have to use a different Log in or can I use the CLO-SET account?** * If you have an old installer on your device and you have access to versions below 2024.0: Use the older login method. Login to the installed version you wish to use with your License ID & Password (same as before) * For 2024.0 and above: you can log in to all CLO Virtual Fashion product (CLO/Marvelous Designer/CONNECT/CLO-SET) websites and software with your CLO-SET account. **6) I have both CLO and Marvelous Designer accounts and I use them frequently. How does it affect me?** You no longer have to use two separate logins! You can continue using your licenses without functional change for both CLO and Marvelous Designer. All you have to do is login with your CLO-SET account. You can check the license information for your products on the CLO or Marvelous Designer websites. **7) I like to use different email addresses for CLO and Marvelous Designer for my own reasons and want to keep them separate. Can I still have separate accounts?** Yes, make sure to use the different email addresses for your CLO-SET merge so that you will have two separate CLO-SET accounts. The accounts are tied to each email address and the licenses associated with each account will be included in that merge. If you wish to unify your email addresses in the future or have other questions, please contact us by [submitting a request](https://clovf.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new). **If you need assistance regarding accounts merging or have questions, please contact us by[submitting a request](https://clovf.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new)****, and our support team will promptly respond to your inquiry.**** **
content_description: This FAQ page provides essential information for existing CLO users about the new login method and account merging process to streamline access to all CLO Virtual Fashion services with a single email account.

title: Troubleshooting Email Changes on CLO-SET
content:
## **Objective** Learn about the error cases and troubleshooting process when [changing your account email](https://clovf.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/9876556955663). **[Important]** You must include a **Trace ID** in your ticket for further support. Please follow instructions below. 1. [Email address already in use](https://clovf.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/9540709934223-Troubleshooting-Email-Changes-on-CLO-SET#h_01HZ6GJTSKHDA3NVX7A330130P) 2. Unable to change email 3. Account region mismatch (*CLO/CLO-SET only) 4. Email Change will affect the plan type [(*CLO only)](https://clovf.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/9540709934223-Troubleshooting-Email-Changes-on-CLO-SET#h_01HZ6J6KENZMPD9GDSAFRES6Q3) ## **Details** #### **1) Email Address already in use**
``` **Error Message** : CLO-SET account already exists with the email that you want to change to. ``` The email address you want to change to already exists in CLO-SET. In this case, the aforementioned account needs to be deleted first, for you to change your current account email to another. If you need further support, please **[submit a ticket](https://clovf.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new?ticket_form_id=9530590112143)** with the Trace ID from your error page. #### **2) Unable to change email**
``` **Error Message** : You cannot change your email. You cannot change your email because the email is already in use as Enterprise or Academy account in CLO.
``` * If you are using an enterprise/academic institution email and would like to change your email, please [contact us](https://clovf.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new?ticket_form_id=9530590112143). * If you are an individual/student user and would like to change to an enterprise/academic institution email, please [contact us](https://clovf.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new?ticket_form_id=9530590112143). ![](https://clovf.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/9882556679311) #### **3) Account Region Mismatch**(*CLO/CLO-SET only)
``` **Error Message** : This email already exists. However, it cannot be changed because it does not match the account type you are currently using. ``` Your email address cannot be changed because your current account is registered as China account and the new email address to be used is registered as a Global account, or vice versa. If you need further support, please **[submit a ticket](https://clovf.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new?ticket_form_id=9530590112143)** with the Trace ID from your error page. #### **4) Email Change will affect the plan type**(*CLO only)
``` **Error Message** : Your License has not expired. You cannot change your email because the CLO license you are currently using has not expired.
``` If you have an active license and changing your email address affects your plan type (e.g., student to individual or vice versa), you won't be able to proceed with the email change. You may need to retain your current email or consider cancelling your subscription to initiate the change. If you don't have an active license and changing your email address affects your plan type (e.g., student to individual or vice versa), your user type will automatically change with the email change. (Individual↔️Student) However, be aware that this may impact the available subscription plans. Only plans corresponding to your updated user type will be available for purchase. If you need further support, please **[submit a ticket](https://clovf.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new?ticket_form_id=9530590112143)** with the Trace ID from your error page. * * * If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to [Contact Us](https://clovf.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new).
content_description: This web page aims to guide users through common error cases and the troubleshooting process for changing their account email, emphasizing the importance of including a Trace ID when seeking further support.

title: USD File Import/ Export (ver 2024.0)
content: **List of Contents** **Import** **Export** ### ### **Objective ** As one of the graphics standard file formats, USD allows you to increase productivity in collaboration with various 3D software. ### **Location** Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Import/ Import (Add)/ Export ▶ USD ### **Operation** **Import** 1. Click the tool /menu in Location. → The Open File window opens. 2. Select the desired file and click the **Open** button. → Import USD window opens. 3. Set the details and click the **OK** button. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Load Type** | Open or add new files. **Object Type** | Select the object type(Avatar, Trims, Scene and Props) of the USD file to be imported. **Scale** | Type in the Scale or select the desired unit. **Translation** | Click the "Align Bottom to Ground" option to set the location of the file as needed. **※ Note:** If you import additional USD files, you can set the location of the object in the X, Y, and Z axis. **Export** 1. Click the tool /menu in Location. → The Open File window opens. 2. Select the desired location and click the Save button. → Export USD window opens. 3. Set the details and click the **OK** button. **Option** | **Description**** ** ---|--- **Prim Path** | Set whether to export Meshes and Materials, and specify the Prim Path to be dependent upon export. Materials are stored in the textures folder within the saved USD file folder. **Object**** **** ** | Select the objects you want to export (Patterns, Avatars, Graphics and Trims). ** Object** | Choose whether to export the selected objects as a single object or multiple objects. ** Thickness** | Choose to export the object with the thickness or not. **Unified UV Coordinates** | Texture information for all garment is exported within UV coordinate values between 0 and 1. **Include Garment Simulation Data** | You can achieve more dynamic clothing for your UE 5.4 scene through the updated USD export for garments, including geometry, materials, and the necessary data for simulation setup. **Scale** | Type in the Scale or select the desired unit. ****
content_description: This webpage serves as a comprehensive guide for importing and exporting USD files, enhancing collaboration and productivity across various 3D software applications.

Follow the indicated guideline below: Topstitch ▶ Select Topstitch Stype with Multiple Stitch Count ▶ Property Editor ▶ Number Tab ▶ **Distance from Stitch 1,2...**** ** 2. Use the drop-down menu next to the option to choose the desired number. → Distance between each Topstitch lines are adjusted accordingly. 3. Adjust **Distance from Stitch** for all Topstitches or [configure to adjust their properties at once.](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360000350228)
content_description: This web page provides instructions for adjusting the distance between Topstitches in a sewing design when using a single Topstitch style with multiple stitch counts, including options for measurement units.

title: [Object Browser] Create Additional Topstitch Style
content: **Objective** Create a new Topstitch style. **Location** Object Browser ▶ Topstitch Tab ▶ **+Add** **Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser ▶ Topstitch Tab ▶ **+Add** → A new item named Topstitch_1 is now being added with the same property of Default_Topstitch. **※ Note:** * Additional items are added with names of Topstitch_1,2,3…. * If there are multiple Topstitch styles in the Topstitch tab when creating a Topstitch on a Pattern, click on the desired Topstitch style and create. * To create an additional Topstitch style with existing *.sst file, navigate to the Library ▶ Hardware and Trims ▶ **Topstitch** and drag and drop the desired Topstitch style to the Topstitch tab. Or, find the Topstitch file in the File Brower window and drag and drop.

title: [Style Property] Topstitch Thread Thickness
content: ### **Objective** Adjust the **Thread Thickness** in the desired measurement unit: inch, millimeter (mm), or centimeter (cm). Topstitch thickness can also be adjusted in industry standard units: Tex, Ticket (Tkt), Metric (Nm), or Denier (Den) (ver4.0.0). **Location** Object Browser ▶ Topstitch ▶ Topstitch Property Editor ▶ **Thread Thickness** **Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser ▶ Topstitch ▶ Topstitch Property Editor ▶ **Thread Thickness** → Adjust the **Thread Thickness** with the desired unit of measurement.
content_description: This webpage provides a step-by-step guide for adjusting thread thickness in various measurement units, ensuring precise customization in the Topstitch Property Editor.

title: [Style Property] Save Created Image as Topstitch File
content: ### **Objective** Save customized Topstitch images in a *.sst format file. ### **Location** Object Browser ▶ Topstitch Tab ▶ **Default Topstitch** ### **Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser ▶ Topstitch Tab ▶ **Default Topstitch** → Properties of the selected Topstitch appear in the Property Editor. 2. Navigate to the Property Editor ▶ Type and select **Texture** from the drop-down menu. 3. Under the **Material** section, select the same structured Topstitch to the one customized. 4. Navigate to the Property Editor ▶ Material ▶ Texture and then click on the Topstitch image icon or the **Search** button. → The Open file window appears. 5. Find the path to the customized images and select the one only with the name of Topstitch (ex. "zigzag.png") and click **Open**. → The program automatically saves all five images in *.sst file according to the defined naming rule. → The image is loaded in actual size which is approximately 2cm and it may look bigger than other preset Topstitches. 6. Navigate to the Property Editor ▶ Material ▶ Preset and enter desired value to the **Stitch Width** menu (ex. 5mm) to adjust its size. 7. On the right top of the Property Editor, there is a **Save** button. Select to save. → The Save file window appears. 8. Enter the desired name and location and save. → The Topstitch is now being saved in *.sst file format. **※ Note:** * Topstitches are classified into two different types depending on the presence and absence of the Stitch Width property. For example, when adding a zigzag-style top stitches, select Overlock or Zigzag as its width needs to be adjustable. **Without Width Property** | Default (Single Needle) ---|--- Default Offset 0 Pick Stitch **With Width Property** | Overlock Zigzag Buttonhole Bar Tack * Make sure all of the Topstitch image files are located in the same path as it will not be saved in the SST file properly. * The image is bigger than the actual size to prevent distortion in resolution when enlarging the image. * Drag and drop the saved SST file directly onto the Topstitch Item List or open it by pressing the **Open** button in the Property Editor. Adjust the property details such as the Length, Offset, Thread Thickness or Color likewise any other Topstitch styles.
content_description: This webpage provides a step-by-step guide for saving customized Topstitch images in the *.sst format, ensuring users can easily manage and adjust their sewing patterns.

title: [Style Property] Create Topstitch Image File
content: ### **Objective** Customize Topstitch images. ### **Operation ** 1. Click on the link below to download the sample Topstitch images in Photoshop file format. [Topstitch Sample Image Download](https://s3.amazonaws.com/CLOdata/Manual_Linked_File_\(DoNotDelete\)/Topstitch_Zigzag.zip) 2. Create five images of Topstitches in each different thread thickness in Adobe Photoshop. 3. Save the images followed by the rules below. →Save the images in *PNG file format. →Name the images as below: **Required File Name** | **Thread Thickness Range of Topstitch Property in Program** ---|--- ※ When modifying the thread thickness value as the right section, images will be opened as the left section. **Zigzag_vertythin.png** | 0.2 - 0.4 mm **Zigzag_thin.png** | 0.5 - 0.6 mm **Zigzag.png** | 0.7 - 1.0 mm **Zigzag_thick.png** | 1.0 - 1.5 mm **Zigzag_verythick.png** | > 1.5 mm →Save all five images in the same location. **※ Note:** * To create top-stitch images, it is needed to have editable software (ex. Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator). * To create one top-stitch, five images of each different thread thickness are required. (Five images are included in the provided Download File.) * If not creating all five images in each different thread thickness, the thread thickness is unable to be modified in spite of modifying the value in Thread Thickness in the Property Editor. * To express transparent background, the *PNG file should contains an alpha channel. [(Creating an alpha channel)](https://helpx.adobe.com/photoshop/using/saving-selections-alpha-channel-masks.html) Simply save the file after adjustments as the provided Download File already includes an alpha channel. * When saving a newly loaded Topstitch style into a file, the program automatically loads all five images and save, all of the images should be in the same path or location in order to work properly.
content_description: This web page provides detailed instructions for customizing Topstitch images in Adobe Photoshop, including download links, image creation guidelines, and naming conventions for various thread thicknesses.

title: [Object Browser] Puckering List Window
content: It is possible to create, copy, apply and set a style in puckering list window. Without any extra setting, Default_Puckering is applied as default. Once Default_Puckering style is modified, it lasts until rerun of the program and it is unable to be deleted.
content_description: This webpage provides guidance on managing styles in the puckering list window, including creating, copying, and applying styles, while highlighting the permanence of the modified Default_Puckering style until the program is rerun.

content: ### **Objective** Create a new Puckering style. **Location** Object Browser ▶ Puckering Tab ▶ **Add** **Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser ▶ Puckering Tab ▶ **Add**** **→ A new Puckering style with the same properties as Default_Puckering is now being added. **※Note:** To create an additional Puckering style with existing *.ptp file, navigate to the folder contains the desired *.ptp file. Then, drag and drop the desired Puckering style to the Puckering tab. Or, find the Puckering file in the File Browser window and drag and drop.
